dossier_meta.paper: When all directed cycles have the same weight
dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open Question on Circular Drawing Characterisation
dossier_meta.statement_text: Is there a theorem that says ``every appropriately connected digraph $G$ contains no thing of type $X$ if and only if $G$ admits a circular drawing''?
dossier_meta.context_text: Thomassen's theorem gives a characterisation of circular drawings in the presence of a specific 2-vertex separator. The authors generalise this into a motivating question and, despite fully characterising weightable digraphs in the paper, explicitly state: ``We still have not come up with the characterization we hoped for of the digraphs with circular drawings.''
